meta.title: Administrator Channel
meta.description: DSH raises one UAC prompt at startup to establish a resident elevation authority; sessions then attach to it by flipping the workbench switch with no further prompt. Elevated commands run through a local named pipe inside the resident helper. The tunnel has no time limits: the UAC wait, the idle auto-close and the per-command timeout are unlimited by default. The helper exits with the DSH host; turning a session's switch off only detaches it.
